description: Suijin OS v7.1.0 — The Clean Memory Release. Every channel that feeds the agent's past into its present is hardened: shared-/tmp scratch warnings and on-target verification rules, cross-target credential rejection at record time, librarian target isolation on memory recall, a three-strike oracle rule that breaks 'one decisive script' spirals, and stale-pause transparency at boot. Live-run fixes: the mesh panel append bug, per-iteration cost accounting, cached mascots + alternate-screen rendering (no flicker), capped JSON arg display, colored card severities, unambiguous phase counts. Neo4j polish: [kg] extra, driver in the Docker image, doctor liveness (UP/DOWN with the JSON fallback named). First console test suite. 2,840+ tests green.
